title: Ukundiza Olwandle Olungenazinkathazo
intro: Cabanga umi emphemeni womkhumbi ogcwele ngokweqile njengoba amagagasi ekhuphuka futhi abasebenzi bephonsa inkatho ukuze banciphise umthwalo. Umuntu oyedwa uya phambili, emukela isiphetho esibonakala sengathi ukuphela, kodwa ukujula kube yindawo yokuthandaza nokubuya. Ngemuva kwaleli zwe umphakathi uxwayisiwe ngesijeziso esizayo, phambili kulele isihe esingalindelekile.
clues: Ngathunyelwa njengesithunywa kubantu abangaphezu kwezinkulungwane eziyikhulu.
Ngishiye abantu bakithi ngithukuthele ngaphambi kokuthola imvume yokuhamba.
Ngagibela umkhumbi ogcwele imithwalo futhi abasebenzi benza inkatho ukuze banqume ukuthi obani abazophonswa olwandle.
Ngaphonswa olwandle futhi ngagwinywa yinhlanzi enkulu kuyilapho nganginecala.
Ngidumise u-Allah ebumnyameni, ngithi akekho unkulunkulu ngaphandle kwakhe nokuthi bengingomunye wabenzi bobubi.
Ngaphonswa ogwini oluvulekile, ngigula, futhi u-Allah wabangela ukuba isitshalo sethanga sikhule phezu kwami, abantu bami bakholwa futhi banikwa injabulo okwesikhashana.
